defaults.source_tree_missing_parent: Groups and material folders whose parent no longer exists went to the top level, as in 0.1
defaults.unknown_node_kind: Chapters of a kind 0.1 did not know were imported as ideas, as in 0.1

defaults.unreadable_source_aliases: Alias lists that could not be fully read kept only what could be read
defaults.unreadable_source_kv_projection: Field orders that could not be read were sorted by when the fields were created
defaults.unreadable_source_template: Text templates that could not be read were not made into templates; the original stays in the book's catalog
defaults.unsupported_table_cell_content: Lists, headings and the like in table cells kept only their text
defaults.unsupported_table_cell_mark: Formatting in table cells that the new version doesn't know was removed; the words stay
defaults.writing_day_duplicate: Several writing-day rows for the same device and day were added together, as in 0.1's heatmap
defaults.writing_day_invalid: Writing days whose date or device could not be read had nowhere to go and were not brought over

privacy.crashLogsDesc: Send sanitized error locations, version and platform to the maintainer to diagnose failures. No manuscript text is included. You can turn this off at any time.
privacy.diagnosticsCopyFailed: Could not write to the clipboard. Clipboard permission may be unavailable.
privacy.diagnosticsDesc: Copy version, platform, feature availability, sync counts/error categories, and update state. It contains no manuscript, credential, project identifier, or absolute path and is never uploaded automatically.
privacy.noteLocal: This build never contacts a Drifting server; your work stays on this device. AI and voice-transcription requests go straight from this device to the provider you chose, under that provider's data and training terms; remote MCP extensions you add also use the network.

errors.invalid: This file is not a valid Drifting backup, or it is damaged. The current library was not changed.
errors.legacy: This is a Drifting 0.1 backup, which this version cannot restore directly. Restore it in Drifting 0.1, then import that library with “Import · Drifting 0.1” on the bookshelf.
errors.newer: This backup was made by a newer version of Drifting. Update the app before restoring it.
errors.unknown: The operation did not finish and the current library was not changed: {{detail}}

backup.exportDesc: Package every project's database together with original image and PDF files into one .drifting file. Use it to restore, or to move to another computer.
backup.missingAssets: {{count}} assets are missing on this device and were not backed up.
backup.restoreDesc: Replace the current library with a .drifting backup. The current library is saved as a pre-restore copy first.

sync.import_files_desc: From Word (.docx), Markdown or plain text.
sync.local_sub: No Drifting account or hosted cloud is used. Export a readable copy whenever you want.
sync.local_title: Your work stays on this device.

projection.offHint: Off: projects no longer write Markdown and outside edits no longer merge back. Existing files stay where they are.
projection.title: Markdown folder

update.check_failed: Couldn't check for updates right now, perhaps there is no connection. Try again later; this version keeps working.
update.install_failed: Drifting {{version}} couldn't be installed when you last quit. This version is unchanged; it tries again next time you quit.
update.install_failed_admin: Drifting {{version}} couldn't be installed when you last quit: the folder Drifting is in can't be written to. This version is unchanged.
update.interrupted: The update didn't finish downloading and was discarded. It downloads again at the next check.
update.local_error: The update couldn't be saved on this computer and was stopped. This version keeps working.
update.older_offered: You're up to date. The update service offers {{version}}, which is older than this version, so it won't be installed.
update.ready_on_quit: Drifting {{version}} is downloaded and its signature verified. It installs when you quit.
update.refused_app: The downloaded update isn't Drifting and was discarded. This version keeps working.
update.refused_signature: The downloaded update failed signature verification and was discarded. This version keeps working.
update.refused_version: The downloaded update isn't the version it claims to be, possibly an older one, and was refused. This version keeps working.
update.server_error: The update service has a problem right now. Try again later; this version keeps working.
update.unavailable: This build has no updater signing key, so it cannot check for updates. Releases downloaded from GitHub can.

agent.body: Reads, searches and edits the whole project. Its changes can be undone from history.
agent.closedBody: The Agent lives in the right sidebar and can read, search and edit the whole project. Open it here.

create.body: What this project can create, as its project template lists it.

home.body: The gate brings you back to this page; All projects is to its left, and the wind chime to its right holds notifications.

moons.body: The crescent opens and closes the left sidebar; the full moon has it fill the middle column, and a second click brings it back. The right side works the same way.
moons.title: Open and fill

tabs.body: The project's entries are split across tabs. The mark at the end of the row adds, orders and removes tabs.
tabs.closedBody: The project's entries are in the left sidebar. Open it here.
tabs.title: Left sidebar

timeline.body: Slides up from under the page and lays out the attached entries by view.
